tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind the rail and content.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, inspector, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised or hovered surfaces; selected rows.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Inputs, popovers, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and around inputs.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, labels. Passes 4.5:1 on surface-1.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only; never body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Golden-hour amber: primary buttons, selection outline, playhead, active nav. One per view where possible.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds for accent callouts and the selected wizard option.

tokens.name: use
tokens.usage: USE disposition. Always paired with the check glyph and the word.

tokens.name: maybe
tokens.usage: MAYBE disposition. Always paired with the half-circle glyph and the word.

tokens.name: reject
tokens.usage: REJECT disposition and destructive actions. Paired with the cross glyph.

tokens.name: user
tokens.usage: Marks decisions the user made (locks, user-set disposition, always/never include) so they read apart from AI suggestions.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system notices and preliminary-analysis banners.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Gradient scrim behind labels on thumbnails and video.

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: Text and icons drawn over footage (thumbnails, video); the same in both themes because footage is not themed.

tokens.name: media-chip
tokens.usage: Backing behind badges and AI chips drawn over footage.

tokens.name: media-overlay
tokens.usage: Backing behind centred notices over footage (360 analysis only, source offline).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gap in compact density.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, library grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on Home and first-run.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips inside tiles, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, cards, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, the app icon.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, progress rings.
